section.56: Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)

56.name_native: Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)

hadiths.text: Narrated Abu Usaid:On the day (of the battle) of Badr when we stood in rows against (the army of) Quraish and they stood in rows against us, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When they do come near you, throw arrows at them
